description.summary: an app's menus in the global menu bar
creates the menu object of an app

request.name: destroy

description.summary: the manager is no longer needed

request.description: The menu objects already created stay valid.

entry.name: already_has_menu
entry.summary: the client already has a menu object

request.name: get_menu

description.summary: the menu object of this client

request.description: One per client: the menus belong to the app, not to one of its windows (the app updates them when its active window changes). The bar shows them while one of the client's windows, or the client itself as the windowless frontmost app, is in front.

request.name: destroy

description.summary: the app has no menus any more

request.description: The bar goes back to the generic menus it shows for apps without a model.

entry.name: invalid_model
entry.summary: the model is not readable or not valid

request.name: set_model
request.description: The file holds the model from offset 0, size bytes long (a sealed memfd is the natural choice). Ossido reads it at once and closes the descriptor: the app can reuse or drop the file after the request. A file that cannot be read, a size of 0 or above max_model_size, invalid JSON or a model past the limits (32 menus, 4096 items, items at most 4 levels below a top-level menu, labels of 256 bytes) is the invalid_model error.

event.name: activated

description.summary: an item was chosen in the bar

event.description: The id of an item of the model, as the app sent it. The model may have changed since the bar showed it: an id the app no longer knows is ignored.
